title: Twin Finder
blurb: Decide whether two shop listings describe the same product.
lesson: Pairwise yes/no judgments are cheap and quick per pair, which adds up at catalogue scale.
why: Each pair of listings is one Noul question: the same product or not. Jev returns a probability, and above one half counts as yes.
Different model, size or colour in similar wording is the trap, so read the item list to see which pairs were missed.
